name: Libram of Tenacity

guaranteedRewards.name: Lesser Arcanum of Tenacity
tooltip: Use: Permanently adds 125 armor to a leg or head slot item. Does not stack with other enchantments for the selected equipment slot.

narrative.offerRewardText: It took Kariel what would amount to several of your lifetimes to complete the libram that you now hold, friend. All for what? So that his disciple could stand in the Burning Steppes and bastardize his research in order to satiate a never ending arcane craving... Curse this foul addiction.I am disgusted with your lack of compassion and insatiable greed. Be gone!
narrative.requestItemsText: Thirty gold, friend. Thirty gold and the required components.
